clips.title: The story
paras: At the Hillsbrad border, Time to Strike carries Lesh's signal east to Tarren Mill. Her coded message moves word from a quiet watch to Forsaken plans against Hillsbrad's humans.

Deathstalker Lesh watches the valley from high ground near the border of Silverpine Forest and the Hillsbrad Foothills. Below, human settlers and militia move through the valley. The Deathstalkers serve as the Undercity's eyes and ears, watching enemy settlements before troops deploy. Lesh stays at her post and asks passing Horde travelers to carry her gathered intelligence down the road to Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Be silent and pay attention, adventurer.

I was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad. My mission is one of reconnaissance. It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once. Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:
"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."
Follow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs. Now, hurry! Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?
Superb news! Hillsbrad is ripe for attack. We can carry out our plan of destruction now. Varimathras will be pleased.
